definitions.d_x: number of root clauses containing variable x in either polarity

theorem_root_safe_pivot.name: EVERY_LEGITIMATE_NONTRIVIAL_ROOT_HAS_AN_ORDINARY_N2_CAPPED_PIVOT
theorem_root_safe_pivot.statement: For every legitimate canonical nonempty root with r>=2, at least one live variable x has exact ordinary elimination raw-bound B_x<N^2. Hence if the frozen solver reaches the ordinary-elimination stage at the root, first_capped_elimination cannot fail for every pivot.
proof: Because all r root variables are live, L>=r; because the root is nonempty, m>=1. Thus N=1+m+L+r>=2r+2, so for r>=2 we have N>=6.
By integer averaging there is a live pivot x with incidence degree d_x<=floor(L/r)<=L/r.
Every root clause has width at most r, so w<=r. If x is pure, exact elimination is pure deletion and is immediately cap-safe.
Otherwise apply the proved bounded-width degree bound: B_x<=s-(w+1)d_x+(2w-1)d_x^2/4 <= s+(2r-1)L^2/(4r^2).
For r>=2, (2r-1)/(4r^2)<=3/16. Also s=N-r<N and L=N-r-m-1<N.
The generic raw-budget lemma then guarantees exact eliminate_var_capped on x cannot abort under the frozen N^2 cap.
theorem_root_safe_pivot.small_r_case: For r=1 the root is a unit/contradictory-unit canonical formula and is handled by exact unit/2-SAT logic; direct elimination is also trivially within N^2. No rescue macro is needed.

corollary_no_extension_as_first_rescue.statement: On every legitimate root, the frozen solver either terminates in an earlier exact lane, performs nonempty unit propagation, or has an ordinary capped pivot. Therefore v2/v3 extension machinery is never the first required nonterminal rescue at the root.

corollary_extension_era_live_ceiling.statement: If a continuing frozen run ever reaches a state at which extension machinery can be relevant, then at least one original live variable has already disappeared without adding an extension. Since all later continuing v2 transitions are live-count nonincreasing and v3 transitions decrease live count, every such state satisfies v_t<=r0-1<=floor((N-2)/2)-1.

relationship_to_N12_census: The general ceiling independently rejects the N12 planted local gap. The exhaustive N12 census is stronger for that one size layer: all 800 legitimate N12 roots terminate without allocating any extension at all.
next_exact_target: Search only adversaries with live_variables<=floor((N-2)/2)-1, or preferably scan legitimate roots directly for the first N whose frozen forward trace allocates an extension or returns OPEN.
